```{r}
data <- format_data(eval(parse(text = fxn)))
data_filtered <- data |>
  dplyr::filter(
    depth <= min_depth, depth >= max_depth,
    latitude >= min_latitude, latitude <= max_latitude,
    year >= min_year, year <= max_year
  )
data_discards <- data_filtered |>
  dplyr::filter(catch_weight > 0, depth < max_depth)
model_terms <- stats::terms(stats::as.formula(formula))
term_factors <- attr(model_terms, "factors")
split_descriptions <- c(
  split_mendocino = "the regions north and south of Cape Mendocino (split at 40.1667 degrees N)",
  split_conception = "the regions north and south of Point Conception (split at 34.45 degrees N)",
  split_monterey = "the regions north and south of 36 degrees N",
  split_state = "the Washington, Oregon, and California regions"
)
split_names <- intersect(names(split_descriptions), rownames(term_factors))
has_term_interaction <- function(first, second) {
  if (!all(c(first, second) %in% rownames(term_factors))) {
    return(FALSE)
  }
  any(term_factors[first, ] > 0 & term_factors[second, ] > 0)
}
year_split_names <- split_names[vapply(
  split_names,
  function(split_name) has_term_interaction("fyear", split_name),
  logical(1)
)]
region_names <- if (length(year_split_names) > 0) year_split_names else split_names
region_description <- glue::glue_collapse(
  split_descriptions[region_names],
  sep = ", ",
  last = " and "
)
text_year_effects <- if (length(year_split_names) > 0) {
  glue::glue("Separate year-specific fixed effects were estimated for {region_description}.")
} else if (length(split_names) > 0) {
  glue::glue("Year-specific fixed effects were estimated. A regional effect was included for {region_description}.")
} else {
  "Year-specific fixed effects were estimated."
}

response_name <- as.character(stats::formula(model_terms)[[2]])
covariate_names <- setdiff(rownames(term_factors), c(response_name, "fyear", split_names))
regional_covariates <- covariate_names[vapply(
  covariate_names,
  function(covariate) any(vapply(
    split_names,
    function(split_name) has_term_interaction(covariate, split_name),
    logical(1)
  )),
  logical(1)
)]
shared_covariates <- setdiff(covariate_names, regional_covariates)
format_covariates <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("_scaled_squared$", " squared", x)
  x <- gsub("_scaled$", "", x)
  gsub("_", " ", x)
}
text_covariates <- if (length(covariate_names) == 0) {
  "No other covariates were modeled."
} else {
  covariate_text <- glue::glue_collapse(
    format_covariates(covariate_names),
    sep = ", ",
    last = " and "
  )
  covariate_sentence <- glue::glue("The following additional covariates were included: {covariate_text}.")
  covariate_sentences <- covariate_sentence
  if (length(split_names) > 0 && length(shared_covariates) > 0) {
    shared_text <- glue::glue_collapse(
      format_covariates(shared_covariates),
      sep = ", ",
      last = " and "
    )
    covariate_sentences <- c(
      covariate_sentences,
      glue::glue("Effects of {shared_text} were shared across regions.")
    )
  }
  if (length(split_names) > 0 && length(regional_covariates) > 0) {
    regional_text <- glue::glue_collapse(
      format_covariates(regional_covariates),
      sep = ", ",
      last = " and "
    )
    covariate_sentences <- c(
      covariate_sentences,
      glue::glue("Effects of {regional_text} varied by region.")
    )
  }
  paste(covariate_sentences, collapse = " ")
}
text_truncation <- ifelse(
  abs(max_depth) != "Inf",
  glue::glue("The data were truncated to depths less than {abs(max_depth)} m prior to modeling given that there were {xfun::numbers_to_words(NROW(data_discards))} positive encounters in depths deeper than {abs(max_depth)} m. The prediction grid was also truncated to only include available survey locations in depths between {abs(min_depth)}--{abs(max_depth)} m to limit extrapolating beyond the data and edge effects."),
  glue::glue("The prediction grid was truncated to only include available survey locations in depths deeper than {abs(min_depth)} to limit extrapolating beyond the data and edge effects.")
)
text_distribution <- ifelse(
  tolower(distribution) == "tweedie",
  glue::glue("The chosen model used a {distribution} distribution."),
  glue::glue("The chosen model used a delta model with a {distribution} distribution for the catch-rate component. A logit-link was used for encounter probability and a log-link for positive catch rates.")
)
```

### \gls{`r text_survey`}

`r text_truncation` 

`r text_distribution`
The response variable was catch (mt) with an offset of area (km^2^) to account for differences in effort. `r text_year_effects`
`r text_covariates`
Vessel-year effects, which were historically used for index standardization of this survey, were not included because the estimated variance for the random effect was close to zero. Vessel-year effects were more prominent when models did not include spatial effects and instead vessel-year terms accounted for the random selection of commercial vessels used during sampling [@helser_generalized_2004; @thorson_accounting_2014].

`r text_spatiotemporal`
Spatial variation was approximated using `r n_knots` knots, where more knots led to non-estimable standard errors because the positive encounters are too sparse to support the dense spatiotemporal structure. Anisotropy `r ifelse(anisotropy, "was", "was not")` included in the model.
